purpose: Recorded-label composition and definition sensitivity; not clinical adjudication, incident-event prediction or new external validation
model: Previously fitted 50:50 XGBoost/RandomForest composite model, five-fold patient-isolated internal OOF, uncalibrated
rules: Use the exact source-code prefix lists authenticated in the 2026-10-20 label contract; any supplied diagnosis position; remove dots and uppercase but do not strip. Retain implementation limitations.
reduced_union: Keep all 9946 admissions; only admissions positive exclusively through the Cardiomyopathy code group become zero. Unstable_Angina is retained and is nested in MI.
comparators: Each label versus all other admissions in the same fixed cohort. Other component-positive admissions remain in the comparator if the target component is absent.
bootstrap_unit: Patient clusters sampled with replacement, retaining every admission and cluster multiplicity
bootstrap_interval: Percentile 95% interval, conditional on fixed OOF predictions and the retained cohort, not refitting uncertainty
china: Counts only: exact original keyword matching and case behavior, row/patient hit counts, overlap and unique contributions. No clinical subtype relabeling or new performance estimates.
context_cue_screen: Literal same-record co-occurrence with uncertainty, negation or history terms; descriptive prompts for future review only, not clinical adjudication or corrected labels
clinical_validation: SOP, blank CRF and adjustable precision planning only; no sampled patient package and no completed manual review
known_boundaries: Original full-admission or full-record feature aggregation remains
Original diagnostic labels are not a clinical reference standard
Original MIMIC source feature mapping defects are not repaired in this fixed-score analysis
China and MIMIC retain different labels and analysis units
No onset or clinical negative capture is validated
